about.metaDescription: NEONS RUNNING is race discovery, registration and results for the Caribbean running community.
about.title: Race discovery for the Caribbean running community.
about.story1: Finding a race on this island has long meant three Facebook groups, a WhatsApp thread and a Google Form that closes without warning. Runners miss races they would have loved. Organizers fill half a start line and never know why.
about.story2: We founded NEONS RUNNING in 2026 to fix that: one place for every road race in Puerto Rico, with listings, registration, payments, participant management, race-day check-in and official results built in.
about.story3: We are a small team of runners in Cabo Rojo. If something in the product is wrong, one of us has probably already heard about it at a start line.

values.runnersFirstBody: Registration takes under a minute and works on a phone with one bar of signal at the expo. No account walls in front of race information.
values.honestPricingBody: One flat service fee, shown before checkout. Organizers keep the rest, and refunds inside the window are automatic — no email chain required.
values.builtWhereWeRunBody: The team is in Cabo Rojo. We stand at the finish lines we sell entries to, and most features come out of a conversation at kilometre eight.

faq.metaDescription: Common questions about registering, refunds, results and publishing events.
faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.introPre: Everything runners and organizers ask most. If your question is not here,
faq.stillStuckBody: Race-day questions get answered fastest by the organizer on the event page. Everything else comes to us.

items.q: Do I need an account to register?
items.a: You can browse every race and read the full event information without an account. Registering creates one, because we need somewhere to keep your bib, your waiver and your results.
Yes. On the runner information step, enter their details rather than yours. The confirmation and bib go to the email you enter there, and the receipt goes to you.

items.q: When do I get my bib number?
items.a: Immediately. Your bib appears on the confirmation screen and on your profile. Physical bibs are collected at the expo or on race morning, depending on the event.

items.q: What if a race is full?
items.a: Full races show a waitlist button instead of Register. If a spot opens, waitlisted runners are offered it in order and have 24 hours to claim it.

A flat $2.00 per registration, shown in the order summary before you pay. There is no percentage cut on top. Puerto Rico sales tax (IVU, 11.5%) applies to the registration, extras, service fee and shipping, but not to donations.

As a general rule, registrations are not refundable once paid — including if you decide not to take part, register by mistake or change your mind. If NEONS RUNNING cancels an event without a reasonable alternative, an item arrives damaged, or you were charged twice, email neonsmultiservicesllc@gmail.com with your confirmation number. The refund policy has the full details.

items.q: What happens if a race is cancelled?
items.a: NEONS RUNNING notifies every registered runner through its official channels, along with the available alternatives — usually a new date. If the event is cancelled for good without a reasonable alternative, any refund that applies goes back to your original payment method. The cancellation policy has the full details.
Show the QR code on your race pass at the check-in tent. It works offline once you have opened it, so no signal at the start village is fine.
Within two hours of the last finisher for chip-timed races. You get a notification the moment yours is live, with your splits, placings and a share card.

items.q: My result is wrong. What now?
items.a: Contact the organizer from the event page — they hold the timing data and can correct it. Corrections propagate to your profile automatically.

items.q: What does it cost to list a race?
items.a: Nothing to list. Runners pay the flat service fee at checkout, and payouts land in your account within five business days of race day.

items.q: Can I move from runner to organizer?
items.a: Yes — switch on organizer tools from your settings. You never need a second account, and your runner profile and results stay exactly as they are.

legal.disclaimer: This policy is written for a product demonstration. Before NEONS RUNNING takes real money, have it reviewed by counsel licensed in Puerto Rico.

settings.notificationsDescription: Race-critical alerts always arrive by email. Everything else is up to you.

prefs.remindersDetail: The day before each race you entered: your bib, start time and place.

prefs.updatesDetail: When a race you entered changes its date, start time or place.

settings.accountTypeDescription: Organizer tools are switched on by the NEONS RUNNING team. You never need a second account, and your results stay exactly as they are.
settings.runnerOn: Register for races and keep your results in one place.
settings.organizerOn: You can publish and manage events from the organizer dashboard.
settings.organizerOff: Want to list races, take registrations and run race-day check-in? Get in touch and we’ll set you up.
settings.adminOn: You’re a platform admin: you can review ATH Móvil payments.
settings.publicProfileDetail: Other runners can find your profile and see your race history. Official results stay public either way — they are a published record.
settings.exportDetail: Downloads a file with your profile, private details, registrations and payments, results and saved races.
settings.dangerDescription: Ask us to delete your account. Our team reviews each request and deletes your profile and personal details, keeping only the payment records we are required to keep.
settings.deleteDescriptionNone: We’ll send your request to our team, who will delete your account and email you when it’s done.

settings.deletionCancelledTitle: Request withdrawn. Your account stays as it is.

publish.metaDescription: List your race on NEONS RUNNING: categories, registration, pricing and race day.
publish.publishedBody: {name} is live on NEONS RUNNING and listed on the events page.
publish.eventNameHint: This is the headline runners see in search results.
publish.eventDescriptionHint: What makes this race worth travelling for? Two or three paragraphs.
publish.eventDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe the course, the atmosphere and what runners should expect.
publish.endDateHint: Leave empty for a one-day race. The event stays listed until this day ends.
publish.startTimeHint: Leave empty if the start time is not set yet.
publish.startTimeHintMultiDay: Leave empty if runners can start any time between the two dates.
publish.locationAnywhereHint: Runners take part wherever they like, so there is no venue or city. Good for virtual races.
publish.categoriesIntro: Add every distance you are offering. Each gets its own price and cap. Leave a start time empty and that distance starts with the event.
publish.extrasIntro: Optional add-ons runners can pick when they register. Switch off anything you don’t offer and runners won’t see it.

extras.shirtDetail: Runners pick a size from the ones you offer.
extras.photosDetail: Race-day photos of each runner who buys the pack.
extras.donationsDetail: Runners can add $5, $10, $25 or an amount of their own to their registration.
extras.donationRecipientHint: The charity, foundation or cause runners are giving to. Runners see this name before they donate.
extras.freeHint: Enter 0 to include it at no cost.
extras.mailDetail: Runners who can’t make packet pickup can have their medal mailed. Shipping and handling is added at the end of their total.
extras.shippingPriceHint: Added at the end of the runner’s total. Enter 0 to ship free.

publish.aidStationsHint: One per line, as: kilometre — what is offered.
publish.dayScheduleHint: One per line, as: time — what happens.
publish.parkingPlaceholder: Where to park, and how to get here.
publish.participantLimitHint: Leave empty to use the sum of the category caps.
publish.daySchedulePlaceholder:
4:00 PM — Check-in opens
6:00 PM — Race start
publish.directionsPlaceholder: How to get here by car, bus or train.

image.intro: The photo runners see on your event card and listing. Optional — without one, the event gets the NEONS cover.
image.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or iPhone HEIC, up to 40 MB. It’s resized and converted to WebP for you. A landscape photo looks best.

routeImage.intro: A map of the course, shown on your event’s Route tab. Optional — without one, the tab shows a simple course diagram.
routeImage.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or iPhone HEIC, up to 40 MB. It’s resized and converted to WebP for you. A screenshot or export from Strava, Garmin or Google Maps works well.

medalImage.intro: The medal every participant receives for completing the event, shown on your event page. Optional — without one, runners see a placeholder medal.
medalImage.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or iPhone HEIC, up to 40 MB. It’s resized and converted to WebP for you. A photo or render on a plain background works best.

publish.draftSavedBody: {name} is saved as a draft. Only you can see it until you publish.
publish.changesSavedBody: {name} is updated on the events page.

results.title: Finish evidence
results.detail: From race day, registered runners can send a screenshot of their run (Strava, Nike Run Club, a watch app) with their finish time. You accept or reject each one from the event page; accepted runners get the result and this medal on their profile.

medalMail.title: Offer finisher medals by mail
medalMail.detail: At sign-up, each runner chooses to pick up their medal in person or have it mailed, at no extra cost to them — build it into your prices. Mailed medals go out once race day is over: you mark each one shipped from the event page and we email the runner. Pickups you mark as runners collect them.
medalMail.detailResults: At sign-up, each runner chooses to pick up their medal in person or have it mailed, at no extra cost to them — build it into your prices. Once you accept a runner’s finish evidence, you mark their medal shipped from the event page and we email them, or mark it picked up when they collect it.

organizerOnly.title: This area is for organizers
organizerOnly.body: Publishing and managing events is open to organizer accounts. If you put on races, contact the team and we’ll switch the tools on for your account.

adminPayments.title: ATH Móvil payments
adminPayments.body: Find each payment in the ATH Móvil Business app — by its reference, the code in the message, or the amount and name — then approve it to confirm the registration and email the runner their bib. Reject one only if the payment isn’t there: the runner’s spot is released.
adminPayments.rejectConfirm: Reject this payment and release the runner’s spot?
adminPayments.approvedBody: {name} has their bib; the confirmation email is on its way.
adminPayments.rejectedBody: {name}’s spot was released. They can pay again from the register page.

eventPayments.title: Pending payments
eventPayments.body: Card payments confirm themselves. ATH Móvil payments wait for you: find each one in the ATH Móvil Business app — by its reference, the code in the message, or the amount and name — then confirm it to give the runner their bib and email it to them. Reject one only if the payment isn’t there; the runner’s spot is released.

raceResult.title: Your result
raceResult.beforeRace: This race takes finish evidence. From race day, send a screenshot of your run here to get your result and medal on your profile.

raceResult.evidenceHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC. Make sure the distance, time and date are visible. Only you and the organizer can see it.
raceResult.finishTimeHint: As h:mm:ss, or mm:ss for under an hour.

raceResult.disqualifiedBody: The organizer disqualified your result. It and the medal were removed from your profile.

resultReview.title: Results to review
resultReview.body: Runners send a screenshot of their run with their finish time. Check that the distance, date and time match this event, then accept it to put the result and medal on their profile. Reject it with a note if it doesn’t — they can send it again.

resultFinishers.title: Reviewed results
resultFinishers.body: Every finish you’ve reviewed. Accepted ones go fastest first; the ones you sent back sit at the end until the runner sends new evidence. If a runner cheated, disqualify their result: it and the medal come off their profile, they’re emailed your reason, and they can’t send evidence again.
resultFinishers.empty: No reviewed results yet. Finishes show up here once you accept or send them back.
resultFinishers.confirmBody: {name}’s result and medal will be removed from their profile, and they won’t be able to send evidence again. Only a NEONS RUNNING admin can undo this.

adminEvents.title: Events
adminEvents.body: Edit any organizer’s event, or remove one that organizers can no longer delete because runners have paid. A removed event leaves listings, search and its page, and takes no sign-ups or results. Its registrations, payments and accepted results are kept, and you can restore it at any time.
